action: Update the Millfield Auto Tech Pipeline board presentation materials to incorporate the RoboRide delivery partnership announcement as a dedicated evidence section. Specifically: name the partnership, note residential coverage expansion, and frame autonomous delivery fleet maintenance as a local employment category that does not yet have a trained workforce in Millfield. Add a single slide or page titled 'The Fleet Maintenance Gap' that connects RoboRide's delivery expansion to the technician pipeline the program produces. This is the most concrete localized evidence the proposal has had. Make sure it is front-loaded in the document, not buried.
